entities.summary: Michael Alan Daum is an American professional basketball player for the Shinshu Brave Warriors of the B.League. He played college basketball for South Dakota State University. A 6 ft 9 in (2.06 m) power forward, Daum was named the Summit League Player of the Year three times.
